acceptance: Upload/download/export preserve original source authorization, file integrity and policy-denied outcomes.

positive.fixture: policy, sandbox, upload with size and sha256 check, download stored only when size and digest agree, real Chromium upload and download
positive.command: env VSF_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome go -C backend test -tags integration -race -count=1 ./execution/ -run RealBrowser|OutsideTheSandbox|ADownload

negative.fixture: zero policy, oversize, wrong media type, bidi and reserved names, symlink escape, another session's reference, lost response after sending

security_and_source_permissions: The zero policy allows nothing; bytes live in a per-session 0600 content-addressed sandbox; a browser gets only paths resolving inside it; a lost upload response is unknown and never retried.
performance_memory_storage: Digest recheck on every read; no measured regression of the Go suite.
known_limitations: File-name handling tested in Chromium 141 on Linux only
Transfers go through a provider file API executor; browser-driven transfers use the sandbox paths only
